valueProposition.headline: Outsource your conscience to a portfolio
valueProposition.body:
We curate 100 high-impact charities across climate, hunger, health, education, and animal welfare. You make one donation. We split it evenly. You get one tax receipt, one warm feeling, and zero decision fatigue.

Think of it as an index fund for your soul. The same logic that beats stock pickers — diversification, low fees, set-and-forget — applied to the part of your life where you keep meaning to do better and never quite get around to it.

items.question: Is this a joke?
items.answer: Half. The mechanism — one donation, split across 100 vetted charities, one receipt, quarterly impact report — is real. The branding is honest about why most people never get around to giving: decision paralysis dressed up as standards. We removed the decision.

items.question: How do I know my money goes where you say?
items.answer: Quarterly impact reports with itemised deployment per charity. Annual third-party audit by a Big Four firm. Every charity in the portfolio is independently rated and re-evaluated yearly.

items.question: What if I want to pick the charities myself?
items.answer: You can. Custom portfolios are available on the Saint Status tier and above. Pick from the curated 100, weight however you want, override our defaults.

items.question: Is this tax-deductible?
items.answer: Yes — you get a single annual receipt covering all 100 charities. We've done the paperwork so your accountant doesn't have to. Valid in NL, BE, DE, UK, US.

items.question: Can I cancel anytime?
items.answer: Anytime, no guilt. The whole point is less guilt, not more. One click cancels. We'll send a final impact report and an emoji of a halo.

items.question: Is this affiliated with a religion?
items.answer: No. We're a secular product with religious copy because the metaphors are sitting right there and pretending otherwise would be more annoying than the joke. The charities span every cause area, not just religious ones.
